title: Pam Summers Raku Workshops - May 16, 2026
bring: up to 4 bisque-fired pots using Stoneware or Raku clay fired to cone 06, or ready-to-glaze bisque pots available for $10-$15 each
source_quote: May 16, 2026 Raku Workshops $150.00 For those with no clay experience as well as experienced potters.
summary: Raku firing workshop for all levels led by Pam Summers. Bring bisque-fired pots or purchase pre-made pots. Includes three Raku kilns, materials, lunch, and studio facilities.
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes a Raku firing experience where glazed pots are fired in a gas-fired kiln, then pulled red-hot and placed in reduction chambers.
evidence_quote: Pots are glazed, dried, and put directly into a very hot kiln where they remain about twenty minutes until the glazes have melted at a temperature of 1820F. The piece is then removed from the gas fired kiln with long Raku tongs and put into a nest of hay or newspaper and covered with a bucket creating a reduction chamber.
